notes: BiS planner: every item shows small icons for where it comes from - dungeon, raid, quest, craft, reputation, vendor, PvP, a drop - with a ring for how hard it is; hover an icon for the place.
What an item adds or takes away is shorter: a score by your spec's weights and the three changes that matter most; hover "+N" for all of them. Losses are orange, not red.
Your set beside another is now icons: the stats that differ, and every slot side by side - press an item of the other set to take it into yours. Every stat is one press away.
The item's set no longer stretches the head of the item panel.
